pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions consist of irregular, non-uniform polygons with jagged, high-angularity edges. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are relatively sharp, transitioning abruptly from dark brown to light tan. Patch size is largest on the upper flank, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space separates the patches. The network features numerous tri-directional and quadri-directional junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively wide and uniform throughout the visible flank, providing clear spatial separation between all dark regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a distinct 1D geometric contour characterized by short, dense, vertical hair projections. This results in a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the out-of-focus background.
